about: Kinds of ceiling lamps for the 3D lighting (CEILING LIGHTS option). colour: red, green, blue, 0..1; strength: times the colour (the game makes it brighter the brighter the ambient light); radius: reach, in lighting-space units (one world unit; a z unit is 3.266); dim: 0..1, how much the lamp lowers the ambient light round it (0.8: to 40 %). A map's lamps are in mapNNN.json; edit, then restart the game (or F5 in lightview).
